artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Viennensis Austri
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing the viewer. She has a calm expression with delicately drawn features and is wearing a wide circular fur hat. She is dressed in historically styled clothing, including a large fur mantle, a patterned collar, and a long skirt. Her hands are inside a fur muff at the center of her body. The background is a plain surface, emphasizing the woman's figure. The image is a finely detailed etching with intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Mulier Wiennensis Austri
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright with her hands clasped at her waist. She has fine facial features and her hair is neatly styled under a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon and feather. She is wearing a long dress with a high collar, a cape-like garment, lace cuffs, and heeled shoes with bows. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Wiennensis in Domo
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile view, standing upright with crossed hands. She has fine facial lines, a composed expression, and styled hair covered by a headpiece. She wears a full-length gown with intricate details, including a large collar and cuffs, a fitted bodice, and full skirt. The background is plain, with a text header and footer in an old-style script.

artworks.title: Mulier Westphalica ex Archiep Monasteri
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her hands clasped in front of her. Her facial features are finely crafted with a serene expression. She wears a head covering, a long dark dress with a high ruffled collar, cuffs, and an apron. The background is simple, emphasizing the woman's traditional attire and posture.

artworks.title: Mulier Franconiensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is facing forward with her hands clasped together at her waist. She has a round face framed by a voluminous hairstyle and wears a high-collared dress with intricate detailing, puffed sleeves, a narrow waist, and a floor-length skirt. The woman wears a lace collar and a key or ornament hangs from her waist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ciuis Norimbergensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in profile, standing with a slight tilt of her head. She has a delicately drawn face with a pronounced nose and softly arched eyebrows, wearing a hat and an elaborate outfit consisting of a cloak over a pleated dress. She is also wearing modest shoes peeking out from beneath the dress. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mercatoris Norimbergensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, with her head slightly turned to the left. She has delicate facial features and her hair is styled into a low bun. She is wearing a dark-colored wide-brimmed hat, a fur-trimmed shawl or cape over a layered gown, and a long pleated skirt. The woman appears to be holding a small object or fabric in her hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Augustana
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length profile of a woman standing, facing to the right. She is depicted with delicate lines, showing a composed expression. She wears a large, wide-brimmed hat with a decorative band and bow. She is dressed in a richly detailed jacket with a high, pleated ruff around her neck and long sleeves. Her voluminous skirt extends to the floor in pleats, and she wears shoes. The background is simple with no other objects, and the illustration is labeled "Mulier Augustana" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Svevica vel Augustana
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a side profile with her hands clasped in front of her. Her facial features include a small nose and lips, and she has tight curls framing her face with the rest of her hair styled under a round hat. She wears a high-necked dress with long, voluminous sleeves, a ruffled collar, and a full, pleated skirt. A belt around her waist holds keys and a small doll or figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Svevica Inferioris Conditionis
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing to the right. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a high collar, holding a basket in her left hand and keys in her right hand. The background is plain, with a line of text below the figure reading "Mulier Suenica inferioris conditionis" and the artist's signature "W: Hollar fecit 1642."

artworks.title: Mulier ex Ducatu Wirttembergensi
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length profile view of a woman standing and facing to the right. She is posed with her hands resting in front of her, holding the edge of her garment. Her facial features are drawn with fine lines, and she has a composed expression. Her hair is styled in a high, rounded manner, possibly with a decorative element at the back of her head. She is dressed in a traditional gown with a high pleated collar, puffed sleeves, and a patterned apron tied around the waist of her long skirt. The figure does not appear to be wearing jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Cives Hollandica
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a frontal position against a textured backdrop. The person has sharp facial features, medium-length hair covered with a headpiece or hood, and is wearing a dark cloak layered over a light dress with decorative elements. Visible underneath the cloak are fur-edged sleeves. The text in the image identifies the person as a "Citizen of Holland."

artworks.title: Mercatoris Hollandici Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a woman labeled as "Marchants-wife of Holland." She stands upright with her body facing forward and her gaze slightly to her left. Her facial features include a neutral expression with pronounced eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and closed lips. She has a high forehead with tightly pulled back hair. She wears a detailed dress with a large ruffled collar, intricately designed sleeves, fitted bodice with buttons, and a long skirt. One hand holds a decorated purse or small bag, while the other rests at her waist. The background is plain, focusing attention on the woman's clothing and posture. The engraving is detailed, with inscriptions in Latin and English providing context to her identity and origin.

artworks.title: Navigatoris Hollandici Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, facing left. She is standing upright with her left arm bent, holding a cylindrical object. The woman has delicate facial features, styled hair under a flat-brimmed hat with a rounded crown. She wears a long gown with a fur-edged collar, puffed sleeves, and a draped skirt. A fabric ruff adorns her neck, and she has simple shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Belgica in Vestitu Domestico
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a lace-trimmed cap on her head, a high-necked blouse with lace cuffs, an ankle-length skirt, a bodice with waist embroidery, and pointed flat shoes. She wears a bracelet on her wrist.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Brabantica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile facing left. She is standing with her hands near her waist, her left arm wrapped around a large muff, while her right hand is not visible. Her face is obscured by shadows cast by her clothing. The woman is wearing a long dress with a textured fabric, and a head covering that conceals her hair. The outfit features lace-like detailing at the neckline. There are visible strands around her wrist that resemble beads or chains. The background is plain with a lightly speckled surface. The style of the image is illustrative, with attention to textures and shading.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Brabantica
artworks.description: This image shows a person standing in profile with their hands clasped together in front of them, facing to the left. The individual has curly hair, wearing a hat with an ornamental pom-pom. They are dressed in a detailed gown with puffed sleeves and a draped garment around the waist. The background is plain, and there is text inscribed at the bottom that says "Mulier Generosa Brabantica."

artworks.title: Mulier Primaria Antuerpiensis, in Ornatu Domestico
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a woman standing, facing slightly to the right. She has visible eyes, a straight nose, and lips slightly parted. Her curly hair falls to her shoulders and is partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat. She wears a dress with a high collar and billowing sleeves, and a cape or shawl on her shoulders. She holds a fan in front of her waist. She stands on unadorned ground with plain background and handwritten script at the top.

artworks.title: Mulier Antuerpiensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright in full-length profile, facing to the right. Her facial features are sharp and detailed, and her hair is covered by a close-fitting cap. She wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long patterned dress with fitted sleeves and a high collar, and a plain apron. She is holding a small wooden container with a handle. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ciuis aut Mercatoris Antuerpiensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to her left. She has a calm expression on her face, with features like a small nose and arched eyebrow. Her hair is wavy and extends past her shoulders, partially covered by a headpiece with a pom-pom. She wears a long dress with vertical stripes, a shawl-like garment, and holds a fur muff. Shoes are visible beneath her dress. The background is plain with script at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Religiosa Antuerpiensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman covered in a dark religious habit, with a veil enveloping her head and a wide-brimmed hat on top. Her hands are clasped at her midsection, and she stands in a straightforward position facing the viewer. The background is neutral, with a caption reading "Mulier Religiosa Antuerpiensis."

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Coloniensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length view, depicted in a side profile. She stands with her hands clasped in front of her, wearing a detailed dress with a wide collar and intricate patterns. She has long, wavy hair and a headpiece with a pom-pom element. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ciuis Coloniesis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile, facing right and holding a small basket with hands clasped in front. The person has a prominent nose and slightly opened mouth, with hair mostly covered by a cloak. They wear an extravagant neck ruff, a hat with a pom-pom, and a multi-layered dress with intricate detailing on the sleeves and hem. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with no specific elements.
